newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Vitoria says air cargo up 49.6 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Vitoria says air cargo up 49.6 pct in April.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Vitoria airport rose 49.6 percent in April, compared with the same month last year, to 2,293 tonnes, the airport authority said.
This follows a 2.4 percent increase in March and takes the total so far this year to 9,244 tonnes, a 23.7 percent increase on 1996.
Intercontinental international freight accounted for 1,075 tonnes of the April total, European Union freight for 751 tonnes and domestic cargo only 467 tonnes.

Vitoria started commercial cargo operations in 1994 and showed monthly growth rates of as much as 150 percent last year. It has become an important centre for frozen fish and express package freight. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
